% --- latex-dual-layer macros (auto-generated) ---
\newlength{\dlboxwidth}
\newlength{\dlboxheight}
\newlength{\dlboxdepth}
\newcommand{\duallayerbox}[2]{%
  \begingroup
  \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{\strut #1}%
  \settoheight{\dlboxheight}{\strut #1}%
  \settodepth{\dlboxdepth}{\strut #1}%
  \ifdim\dlboxwidth=0pt
    \settowidth{\dlboxwidth}{#2}%
  \fi
  \raisebox{0pt}[\dlboxheight][\dlboxdepth]{%
    \makebox[\dlboxwidth][l]{\resizebox{\dlboxwidth}{!}{\strut #2}}%
  }%
  \endgroup
}

\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item According to the recommendations for the nutritional management of patients with diabetes,
the consumption of saturated fat should be:
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item \textless{}10\% of total daily energy
    \item \textless{}12\%
    \item \textless{}15\%
    \item \textless{}16\%
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following statements is true:}{Which of the following statements is false:}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Childhood stunting before 24 months of age affects short term cognitive performance
    \item Childhood stunting before 24 months of age affects long term cognitive performance
    \item Neither of the statements are correct
    \item Both of the statements are correct
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{The "fear of becoming fat" observed in patients with AN is best understood as a:}{A fixed false belief about having parasites inside the body is best understood as a:}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Paranoid delusion
    \item Somatic delusion
    \item Overvalued idea
    \item Obsessive idea
\end{enumerate}
\item Which of the following is the most frequently used anthropometric measure to estimate body
mass?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Fat-free mass
    \item Body fat
    \item Body height
    \item Body weight
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following statements is not true?}{Which of the following statements is true?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Docosahexaenoic acid can be synthesised from linolenic acid in vegans
    \item Docosahexaenoic acid is absent from vegan diets
    \item Lack of docosahexaenoic acid in vegans causes visual and cognitive impairment
    \item Microalgae can be used to synthesise docosahexaenoic acid
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\section*{True / False (10 marks)}
\textit{Answer True or False}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\setcounter{enumi}{5}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Facial flushing is seen in about 50\textbackslash{}\% of East Asians due to a deficiency of ALDH2.}{Facial flushing is never seen in East Asians after alcohol consumption.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Intrauterine growth retardation (IUGR) is defined as birth weight below a population threshold for gestational age.}{Intrauterine growth retardation (IUGR) is defined as birth weight above the 90th percentile for gestational age.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Orlistat is an approved drug for the treatment of obesity in Europe.}{Orlistat has never been approved anywhere for the treatment of obesity.}
\item True or False: \duallayerbox{Sodium is a dietary component that has been proven to improve hypertension in humans.}{Reducing excessive sodium intake can help lower blood pressure in humans.}
\item True or False: Epigenetic changes can include DNA methylation and modify gene expression without altering the DNA sequence.
\end{enumerate}
